## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Minerva Tanglao Ott (Minnie) is a Silicon Valley engineering leader, Head of Technology at Creative Blue, and Senior Technical Program Management (TPM) leader with over two decades of experience leading transformative technology programs across Google, Apple, Sun Microsystems, and enterprise startups. 

Her career spans the modern history of computing—from self-taught BASIC programming as a teenager to managing Java Management Extensions (JMX) at Sun Microsystems, launching global HR software at Apple across 80+ countries, directing Google Maps voice navigation integrated with Gemini AI, and leading Agentic AI platform transformations at Creative Blue.

## CAREER TIMELINE & LEADERSHIP RECORD

### 1. Creative Blue (Dec 2024 – Present)
- **Role**: Head of Technology & Executive Strategy
- **Location**: San Francisco Bay Area, CA
- **Overview**: Leading technology strategy, engineering execution, and Agentic AI platform deployment for agency operations.
- **Key Achievements**:
  - Architected and launched **GrowthOS**, an enterprise AI operations engine automating lead intelligence, brand assessment, and strategic agency workflows.
  - Implemented Model Context Protocol (MCP) standards and multi-agent coordination pipelines reducing campaign delivery cycles by over 40%.
  - Oversaw product development across Lead Generator, Brand Assessment, Grex World, and Just Ride telemetry pipelines.

### 2. Google (Jun 2011 – Nov 2025)
- **Role**: Senior Engineering Program Manager / Technical Program Manager
- **Location**: Mountain View & Sunnyvale, CA
- **Overview**: Spent 14+ years managing major technical infrastructure, consumer product features, and enterprise service management across Google Geo / Maps and Corporate Engineering.
- **Key Achievements**:
  - Led engineering program delivery for **Google Maps Voice Navigation**, integrating Gemini AI models for multi-lingual natural language voice guidance used by over 1 Billion active users globally.
  - Spearheaded Google's internal **Service Desk Infrastructure & Operations**, scaling global support systems for 150,000+ Google employees across 50+ countries.
  - Championed diversity and leadership initiatives, founding and co-leading **Stanford LEAD @ Google**, an executive peer network spanning hundreds of Google leaders.
  - Directed cross-functional vendor operations and software development lifecycle (SDLC) governance frameworks for major GCP cloud migrations.

### 3. Apple (Jun 2009 – Jun 2011)
- **Role**: Technical Project Manager, Information Systems & Technology (IS&T)
- **Location**: Cupertino, CA
- **Overview**: Managed end-to-end software development lifecycle and global rollout of Apple's corporate HR and recruitment platforms.
- **Key Achievements**:
  - Directed the global release of the **Apple Job Search Portal**, localized across 80+ countries and integrated with internal HRIS databases.
  - Reduced system latency and improved recruitment pipeline throughput for high-volume Apple retail and corporate hiring.

### 4. Sun Microsystems / Oracle (2000 – 2008)
- **Role**: Software Engineer, Program Architect & Technical Editor
- **Location**: Santa Clara, CA
- **Overview**: Core contributor to Java enterprise standards, JMX (Java Management Extensions) program management, and developer tools.
- **Key Achievements**:
  - Served as **Technical Editor** for the landmark book *JMX Programming* (John Wiley & Sons, 2002).
  - Co-authored **US Patent 20020064766** on Enterprise Employee Training Management Systems.

## PUBLICATIONS & INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

### 1. Book Publication (Technical Editor)
- **Title**: *JMX Programming*
- **Author**: Mike Jasnowski
- **Technical Editor**: Minerva Tanglao Ott
- **Publisher**: John Wiley & Sons (2002)
- **ISBN**: 0-471-22927-4
- **Summary**: Comprehensive guide to Java Management Extensions (JMX) architecture, Standard, Dynamic, and Model MBeans, MBeanServer implementation, protocol adaptors (RMI, HTTP/XML, SNMP), and enterprise application monitoring.

### 2. United States Patent US 20020064766 A1
- **Title**: Method and Apparatus for Managing Enterprise Employee Training Systems
- **Inventors**: Minerva Tanglao Ott et al.
- **Abstract**: An automated organizational training management system performing skills gap analysis, dynamic course assignment, automated compliance auditing, and organizational learning resource allocation.

   Minerva Tanglao Ott (Minnie) is an executive engineering leader, Head of Technology at Creative Blue, and former Senior Engineering Program Manager at Google and Apple.

   Minnie Ott is currently the Head of Technology at Creative Blue, where she builds AI-driven agency platforms like GrowthOS. She previously worked at Google for 14 years and Apple for 2 years.
